record.question: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has revolutionized digital payments in India. A key technical feature that enables its high volume of real-time transactions is its:
options: Dependence on a centralized server managed by the Reserve Bank of India.
Use of a distributed ledger system similar to blockchain.
Operation as a single-bank, closed-loop system for security.
Three-tier architecture that decouples the payment service provider from the bank's core banking system.
